title: Robust Conformal Consensus: Multi-Agent LLM-as-a-Judge Interval Evaluation with Conformal Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.06367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge has emerged as a promising paradigm for evaluating natural language generation. However, the uncertainty associated with such evaluations remains largely unexplored, which limits their reliability in real-world applications. Although conformal prediction offers a principled framework for uncertainty quantification, existing approaches typically apply it to a single LLM judge, overlooking the variability introduced by using different LLM evaluators. In this work, we propose a robust uncertainty estimation framework for multi-agent LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. Our approach constructs conformal prediction intervals for LLM-based scores from multiple LLMs. By considering intervals from different LLM judges, we obtain more stable and reliable uncertainty estimates. translated_title: 鲁棒共形共识：基于共形预测的多智能体LLM-as-a-Judge区间评估
translated_abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge已成为评估自然语言生成的一种有前景的范式。然而，与此类评估相关的不确定性在很大程度上仍未被探索，这限制了其在现实应用中的可靠性。尽管共形预测为不确定性量化提供了一个有原则的框架，但现有方法通常将其应用于单个LLM评判者，忽视了使用不同LLM评估器所引入的变异性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种面向多智能体LLM-as-a-Judge评估的鲁棒不确定性估计框架。我们的方法为来自多个LLM的评分构建共形预测区间。通过综合考量来自不同LLM评判者的区间，我们获得了更加稳定和可靠的不确定性估计。大量实验表明，我们的方法能够产生具有覆盖率保证的有效预测区间，并且基于区间对多个评判者进行聚合能够带来更好的效果。
tldr: 提出了一种基于共形预测的多智能体LLM-as-a-Judge鲁棒不确定性估计框架，通过聚合多个LLM评判者的预测区间，实现了具有覆盖率保证的更稳定、更可靠的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a robust uncertainty estimation framework for multi-agent LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation that constructs conformal prediction intervals from multiple LLM judges, achieving more stable and reliable uncertainty estimates with coverage guarantees.
